import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# First, identify station types and area types
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_type, area_type
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(stations)

# GENERAL URBAN station IDs: 1,3,4,7,9,12,15,18
# ROADSIDE URBAN station IDs: 14,16,17

query = text("""
WITH general_urban AS (
    SELECT datetime, AVG(no2) AS general_no2_mean, AVG(pm10) AS general_pm10_mean
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality
    WHERE station_id IN (1,3,4,7,9,12,15,18)
      AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
      AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND no2 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY datetime
),
roadside_urban AS (
    SELECT datetime, AVG(no2) AS roadside_no2_mean, AVG(pm10) AS roadside_pm10_mean
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality
    WHERE station_id IN (14,16,17)
      AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
      AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND no2 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY datetime
),
no2_pairs AS (
    SELECT g.datetime, g.general_no2_mean, r.roadside_no2_mean
    FROM general_urban g
    INNER JOIN roadside_urban r ON g.datetime = r.datetime
),
pm10_pairs AS (
    SELECT g.datetime, g.general_pm10_mean, r.roadside_pm10_mean
    FROM general_urban g
    INNER JOIN roadside_urban r ON g.datetime = r.datetime
    WHERE g.general_pm10_mean IS NOT NULL AND r.roadside_pm10_mean IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM no2_pairs) AS no2_pair_count,
    (SELECT CORR(general_no2_mean, roadside_no2_mean) FROM no2_pairs) AS no2_corr,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm10_pairs) AS pm10_pair_count,
    (SELECT CORR(general_pm10_mean, roadside_pm10_mean) FROM pm10_pairs) AS pm10_corr
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)

no2_pair_count = int(result['no2_pair_count'].values[0])
no2_corr = round(float(result['no2_corr'].values[0]), 6)
pm10_pair_count = int(result['pm10_pair_count'].values[0])
pm10_corr = round(float(result['pm10_corr'].values[0]), 6)

print(f"no2_pair_count: {no2_pair_count}")
print(f"no2_corr: {no2_corr}")
print(f"pm10_pair_count: {pm10_pair_count}")
print(f"pm10_corr: {pm10_corr}")
